description.value: The study tested whether medial orbitofrontal cortex gray matter volume was reduced in abstinent substance-dependent individuals compared with control subjects and examined relationships between medial OFC gray matter and decision-making behavior.

spans.text: We tested the hypothesis that medial OFC gray matter (GM) volume would be lower in SDI compared with control subjects.

design.value: Nineteen substance-dependent individuals and 20 control subjects underwent high-resolution T1-weighted MRI. Voxel-based morphometry was analyzed with whole-brain ANCOVA, covarying for global gray matter and age, with an additional medial OFC ROI analysis.

spans.text: Nineteen SDI and 20 control subjects participated.
Differences in regional GM volume were tested with an analysis of covariance model, co-varying for global GM and age.
